agency.name: California Department of Tax and Fee Administration (CDTFA)

authority.citation: Cal. Rev. & Tax. Code §6201 et seq. (Sales and Use Tax Law)

name: Use Tax
notes: The companion to the sales tax, owed on purchases from a retailer for storage, use or consumption in California. The 7.25% statewide base rate is the sum of several state components and a 1.25% local component. District taxes of 0.10% to 2.00% may apply on top, depending on location. Revenue collected has not yet been sourced.

rates.applies_to: the sales price of tangible personal property stored, used or consumed in California (statewide base rate)
